name: Food truck
placement: On level paved ground or a drive, 15 ft from entrances and 10 ft from tents, with a 1.2 to 1.8 m service zone and queue space at the order window.
modeling: A body box 6.1 x 2.6 x 2.4 m at 0.6 m high, a cab box at one end, four wheel cylinders 0.9 m across, a serving window cutout drawn as a glass box on the long side, and an awning from a tilted thin box above it.
